scope: Full unpaced, fresh-nonce complete pipeline at unchanged provider-reported 165 W GPU-board limit. Board energy includes launch/idle gaps within blocks; CPU, PSU, setup and between-block validation excluded.

sensor: 10-Hz NVML instantaneous-power trapezoidal integration; sampled average power and energy counter are cross-checks, not independent calibrated instruments.
